data.name: Muntasiriyyah
data.gender_notes: Muntasiriyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the root word 'nasara' which means 'to fight'. Muntasiriyyah means a determined, resolute, and fighter woman. This name is often given to girls who are expected to face challenges with courage and determination. The name Muntasiriyyah carries the meaning “Determined, Resolute, Fighter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muntasiriyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody determined, resolute, fighter and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Muntasiriyyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Determined, Resolute, Fighter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muntasiriyyah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

Many women, some of whom are named after this title, have made remarkable contributions to the religious and social fabric of Islamic society. The name Muntasiriyyah signifies the strength and resilience of women and their role as protectors and providers.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Muntasiriyyah carries a deep significance. It is a reminder of the essential spiritual essence of all human beings, which is to persevere in the face of challenges. In Islamic theology, this perseverance is seen as a form of spiritual struggle or 'Jihad', which involves striving towards achieving God's pleasure and fulfilling His commandments. By granting the name 'Muntasiriyyah' to a girl, parents are instilling a sense of spiritual determination and resilience, encouraging her to overcome challenges with courage and conviction.
